why._resolved_three_rivers_2026_08_26: RESOLVED without a Matt decision: the evidence answered it. Three Rivers is a census-designated PLACE of 4,819 acres made of 20+ subdivisions (our own cited content names Water Wonderland, DRRH and River Meadows among them), so all 11 aliases are genuine area members; the boundary polygon was the wrong test, covering only 51.9% of the CDP. The 8 aliases that failed it sit CLOSER to the CDP centre (1.1-2.8 km) than the 3 that passed (3.05-4.12 km). Aliases kept; the polygon is logged for widening in the entry's verification block.
why._resolved_crosswater_2026_08_26: RESOLVED by research at Matt's direction. Osprey Pointe Condo KEPT: its recorded declaration (Deschutes 97-33704, Book 462 Page 1137) names Crosswater Owners' Association as its master association and submits the condominium to the Crosswater Master Declaration; it is a condo carved out of Crosswater, which is why the plat-union polygon misses it. Pace Estate and Lisle Acres REMOVED: no association owns a parcel in either plat, MLS carries CCR's YN = No, and the active Lisle Acres listing says 'just outside the resort area with no HOA & no CC & Rs'. This overturns two thirds of Matt's 2026-05-15 directive on evidence he asked for.
